stem.text: An alcohol, $\text{ROH}$, reacts reversibly with ethanoic acid to produce an ester.
$3.0\text{ mol}$ of $\text{ROH}$, $2.0\text{ mol}$ of ethanoic acid and $1.0\text{ mol}$ of water are mixed together. At equilibrium, $1.5\text{ mol}$ of $\text{CH}_3\text{COOR}$ is present.
What is the value of the equilibrium constant, $K_\text{c}$, for this reaction?
